    rows = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1]
    cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    rb, cb = [-1] + rows + [h], [-1] + cols + [w]
    from collections import Counter
    colors = Counter(v for r in range(h) for v in grid[r]
                      if r not in rows and all(grid[rr][c] == v for rr in []))
    # Determine the panel background from the most common color among cells
    # (separator colors are excluded by slicing the panels).
    panel_cells = [grid[r][c] for i in range(len(rb)-1) for j in range(len(cb)-1)
                   for r in range(rb[i]+1, rb[i+1]) for c in range(cb[j]+1, cb[j+1])]
    counts = Counter(panel_cells)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    marker = next((v for v, n in counts.most_common() if v != background), None)
    out = []

 "content": "from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Uniform full rows and columns are the separators; slice the enclosed panels.
    sep_rows = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    rb, cb = [-1] + sep_rows + [h], [-1] + sep_cols + [w]
    panels = [[grid[r][c]
               for r in range(rb[i] + 1, rb[i + 1])
               for c in range(cb[j] + 1, cb[j + 1])]
              for i in range(len(rb) - 1) for j in range(len(cb) - 1)]
    counts = Counter(v for panel in panels for v in panel)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    marker = next(v for v, _ in counts.most_common() if v != background)
    return [[1 if sum(v == marker for v in panels[i * (len(cb)-1) + j]) >= 2 else background
             for j in range(len(cb) - 1)] for i in range(len(rb) - 1)]
"
}
